newsitem.title: UK: Mowlem up on H1 results, floatation.
newsitem.headline: Mowlem up on H1 results, floatation.

text.p: Shares in building to management services group John Mowlem bounced to their highest level in almost two months after delivering strong interim results and raising the possibility of a partial floation of one of its units, traders said.
Its shares were up 6-1/2p to 87-1/2p by 0832 GMT.
The company posted pre-tax profits of 5.3 million stg for the first half, compared with a loss of 32.0 million stg in the year ago period. It also raised its dividend to 1p from nil a year ago.
Additionally, John Mowlem said it was considering the partial floation of its access products and services unit in 1997.
